test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the official language of Bhutan, a neighbouring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dzongkha__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The official Language of Bhutan is Dzongkha__.
 
• The capital of Bhutan is Thimphu.
 
• The national animal is Takin (cattle chamois or gnu goat)
 
• The national bird is Common Raven
 
• The national flower is Blue poppy.
 
• The national sport is Archery.
 
• The national tree is Bhutan Cypress.
